SAME DAY EDIT: ANNIVERSAYA SA BARRIO FIESTA 🎉✨

What. A. Night. 💛

Truly a celebration to remember—complete with fun games, jaw-dropping performances, kilig moments, and even fireworks lighting up the sky for our one and only JM Fyang. 

This event wasn’t without its hurdles—extreme traffic from the thunderstorm, unexpected financial difficulties, last-minute confirmation too close to the event date, and even a sudden change of venue. But you know what? Every challenge was worth it because of the love, support, and joy everyone brought to this celebration. 

Special thanks to our hardworking admins and team live who tirelessly set up the venue and made sure everything ran smoothly. Your dedication made this night possible. 

To our generous sponsors and donors, thank you for standing with us, believing in this community, and sharing your resources to make this celebration possible. Your support lit up the event and gave everyone a night to remember. You are an invaluable part of this journey, and we are deeply grateful. 

To everyone who dressed up, showed up and attended the event on-site, and those who tuned in via livestream, you made this celebration shine brighter! 

Big thanks to Mak ni Ali for lending us the beautiful Anniversary video that added so much heart to this celebration. 

Special acknowledgment as well to Ms. Mave of Mang Inasal for gracing the event with her presence and support. And to JMFyang’s powerhouse team — RMs Ms. Nicole Uy & Ms.  Nichole Peña, their beautiful managers Ms. Portia Dimla & Ms. Gidget Dela Cuesta, Ms. Manel Sevidal, and Manila Creative Artists Agency, Ms. Japeth Purog, Ms Aryan Buccat, thank you for your unwavering guidance and support toward JMFyang, we appreciate everything that you do for them. 

Most of all, our deepest gratitude goes to JM and Fyang. This entire AnniverSaya was for YOU — our inspiration, our source of joy, and the reason this fanmily came together. Thank you for taking the time to prepare, for being present with us, and for allowing us to celebrate YOU in the biggest way we could. Every laugh, every cheer, and every firework was in honor of the love and light you bring to our lives. 

This unforgettable event was made possible by JMFYANG OFFICIAL along with its Chapters & Affiliates:
- ATES OF JMFYANG
- JMFYANG Davao-Bisdak Official
- JMFYANG ROYAL FAM DUBAI OFC 
- JMFYANG Serenity 
-  JMFYANG Gensan Chapter

- JMFYANG Bacolod Chapter 
- JMFYANG Cebu Chapter 
- TEAM MALAMANG ABROAD 
- TEAM JMFYANG ABROAD OFC
- JMFYANG INTERNATIONAL

And with the special participation of our ever-passionate fandom groups:
- Mafia’s of JMFyang 
- JMFyang Main 
- JMFyang Hayati 
- JMFyang Loyalists 
- Thirsties of JMFyang 
- JMF Sampunatics
- JMF Sindikatos 
- Kulto ni Jinx 
- Perpek GDM 
- JMFyang Team Online 
- JMFyang Editor’s League 

To everyone who shared their time, energy, and love, this is YOUR victory too. Here’s to more anniversaries, more milestones, and more memories together. 🥂💛

Relive the magic and watch our Same Day Edit video to sum up the fun evening. It’s everything we dreamed of and more! 

Stay tuned, exclusive pictures are coming soon! 

@imsofiasmith @jmdibarra_

NEWS UPDATE | The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) confirmed that no Filipinos were killed in the recent New York bus crash, as verified by New York State Police.

“No one has approached the Consulate for assistance thus far. It provided its hotline number in social media advisories,” the statement reads.

On Saturday, August 23, the Consulate General of the Philippines in New York posted contact information for anyone needing assistance related to the incident.

“For the victims of the accident or their next of kin, the Consulate can be reached at the Assistance-to-Nationals Hotline (917) 294-0196,” the Consulate stated. | via Katrina Manubay
